title: AS-REP roasting
attack: Find an account with Kerberos pre-authentication disabled, request a ticket for it without knowing the password, and crack it offline.
defend: Event 4768 on the domain controller for a dormant account, from an address that is not a DC, with status 0x0. One event, and it stands out against a baseline of requests from ::1.

title: RDP brute force
attack: Run a password list against RDP on the domain controller from the Kali box.
defend: A storm of Event ID 4625 failed logons from a single source, visible on the Wazuh dashboard as it happens.

title: Delegation abuse (RBCD)
attack: With write access to msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity on a computer object, add a machine account you control and impersonate an administrator to that host.
defend: Alert on any write to msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity, and set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0 so a standard user cannot create the machine account in the first place.
